units.source_text: 我笨手笨脚地把衣服脱了下来。

en.t: I clumsily took off my clothes.

units.source_text: 鞠子将一件粉红毛巾浴衣披在肩上，灵巧地脱下了西服。

en.t: Mariko draped a pink terry-cloth yukata over her shoulders and deftly took off her Western clothes.

units.source_text: 我把枕边的水咕嘟咕嘟地喝了几口。

en.t: I took several gulping sips of the water beside my pillow.

units.source_text: 女人听见喝水声，依然背冲着我，含笑地说道：

en.t: Hearing the sound of me drinking, the woman still kept her back to me and said with a smile:
